name: smartcart-tailwind-deps
description: Tailwind CSS dependencies for SmartCart. This is NOT the React app - that is one level deeper in smartcart/smartcart/. This file exists only to print a helpful message when npm is run in the wrong place.

scripts.wrong-folder: node -e "console.log('');console.log('  WRONG FOLDER');console.log('  ------------');console.log('  You are in:  smartcart\\smartcart\\  (Tailwind deps only)');console.log('  This folder has NO React app.');console.log('');console.log('  Go ONE FOLDER DEEPER. Run these two lines:');console.log('');console.log('     cd smartcart');console.log('     npm run dev');console.log('');console.log('  Tip: run \"dir\" after cd. If you do not see vite.config.js, you are one level too high.');console.log('');process.exit(1);"
